intro.text: The helmsman of the ship First Dreams.

items.text: Droz sailed with Captain Vazrmeb in search of treasure on the island of Akinah in Aimia, eager to go because he believed rumours that generations of greatshells had left their gemhearts there.

The First Dreams sailed north from Liafor and hit a fierce storm on the Aimian Sea that ended abruptly near Akinah. Droz kept the ship afloat, though some of the crew were swept overboard. He set out for the island in one of the dinghies, but the ship's cook poisoned him along with the rest of the crew.

appearance.text: A lanky Liaforan with dark brown eyes and skin.

personality.text: Curious about Kaza's royal blood and her Soulcasting, he strikes up a conversation with her before she scares him off.
